rows.en:
(School's finally out. Maybe I'll stop somewhere
on the way home. Huh, who's that over there...)
Hey, Luca.

Oh, \p-san.
Are you heading home now?
Yeah. You too, Luca?
Yes, that's right.
rows.notes: 6 uses: Luca here, the player in nml_cla, Shirakawa in nml_myk; generic.

rows.en: Then wanna stop somewhere on the way?
Sounds good. Let's go.
(We just kind of ended up in Deep Akihabara...)
rows.notes: Deep Akihabara is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en: Is there anything you want, Luca?

Come to think of it, the vacuum cleaner at home
has been acting up. Mind if we go take a look?
Sure, I don't mind.
(Two hours to pick out a vacuum cleaner...)
Sorry for making you tag along for so long.

You were really serious about picking one.
As a technical adviser to L.A.I.'s research labs,
are there things you can't compromise on?
rows.notes: L.A.I. giken = L.A.I.'s technical research labs; no glossary entry.

rows.en: Every manufacturer's model has its pros and cons.

If the suction is great, it eats a lot of power,
and if it saves power, it's too weak...

Then why not build your own vacuum cleaner?
That'd be a piece of cake for you, Luca.

Yes, that's exactly what I have in mind,
so I held off on buying one today.
Oh, I see...
rows.notes: 5 uses (frd_luk, frd_yuu, nml_nns), all the player; as c06879 'Oh, I see.'

rows.en: (I was only half joking...)

Well then, I'm going to look for some parts
before I head home.
Yeah, see you later.
Okay, see you at school!
(Luca really is a genius...)
Hello, Luca-kun.
Yeah. You too, Luca-kun?
Then shall we stop somewhere on the way?
Is there anything you want, Luca-kun?
Sure, I don't mind.

You were really serious about picking one.
As a technical adviser to L.A.I.'s research labs,
are there things you can't compromise on?

Then how about building your own vacuum cleaner?
That'd be a piece of cake for you,
wouldn't it, Luca-kun?
(I was only half joking...)
Okay, see you later, then.
rows.notes: 4 uses: the female player here, Claire in nml_cla and a Valentine sub-scene.

rows.en: (Luca-kun really is a genius...)
(Okay, school's out.)

Hey, Luca.
What's up? Heading home now?
Yes. Shall we walk home together?
Sounds good.
By the way, did you finish the vacuum cleaner?

No. Once you actually start building one,
it's hard.

Getting strong suction and quiet operation
together, making it lighter... I've got
a mountain of problems...

(Hasn't he kind of drifted away from
what he set out to do?)
rows.notes: The original goal was replacing the vacuum at home.

rows.en: Be sure to show me when it's done.

Of course!
I'll build the best vacuum cleaner in the world!
Ahaha, good luck with that...
(It's great to be able to get so into something.)
(School's finally out.)

Hm? Luca-kun.
What's up? Heading home now?

(I promised Luca we'd do some training
together today, but...)
(Oh, there's Luca.)
Hello, \p-san.
rows.notes: 9 uses: Luca (both genders), and Shirakawa once in frd_myk.

rows.en: So, what should we start with today?
Strength training, I'd say.
...Luca... Do you want to be all macho?
Th-that's not it!
(A macho Luca, huh...)

You're stronger than you look.
Bench-pressing 40 kg...
I may not look it, but I am a pilot.

I can't let you beat me.
All right, Luca, 50 kg!
A-are you sure about that?
No problem!
Don't blame me for whatever happens...
Ow, ow...
I told you so~
I'll patch you up, so take off your shirt.
Ow, ow, ow...
Sorry...

Getting hurt while training is just silly,
you know. Do you understand?
You're absolutely right...
Please reflect on this properly.
You've really got your head on straight, Luca.

I still have a long way to go.
So let's keep at it together!
Good work today.
I'm totally beat.

Make sure you cool down properly.
You pushed yourself way too hard.
Okay, got it.
rows.notes: Also the male player in a scd_com scene.

rows.en: Well then, I'll head out first.
Yeah, see you next time.
(Now, I'll head home and give myself a massage...)

(I promised Luca-kun we'd do some training
together today, but...)

uncertain: c08841/c08857: L.A.I. giken rendered 'L.A.I.'s research labs' (no glossary entry for giken).
c08835: Deep Akihabara is 'provisional' in locations.json.
